title: Substitution is free. Synthesis costs in proportion to what it has to invent. — three contexts, two architectures, two mechanisms with task-weight gradient
description:
This record archives the joint discovery of a cap-floor mechanism in LLM cognitive scaffolds. Three independent sovereign stacks (Triava Labs gemma4:26b sovereign-Ollama / JAMES gemma4:e4b local-stack with wiki corpus / Provia Arabic e-commerce refund fixture on gemma4:e4b) converged on a single architectural property: substitution mode operates as a verbatim-retrieval floor-immune path with byte-identical determinism across model scales, while synthesis mode incurs a task-weight-proportional token cost that scales gradient-wise with what the model has to invent.

The 3-axis structure: (1) mode split (substitution vs synthesis), confirmed by Robin Converse on 26b sovereign infrastructure; (2) workload gradient, measured by JAMES on e4b as a 7-tier monotonic natural-stop gradient (62 → 1681 tokens, 27× dynamic range, per-tier cross-sweep variation within 3-5%) — Direction 1 closure, PR #461/#463, archived as 10.5281/zenodo.20363998; the earlier V3'.e refined Pattern S (PR #440) is the 3-level precursor (heavy / light / no synthesis), not the 7-tier result; (3) model-scale efficiency (synthesis token cost ∝ 1/parameter-count), discovered by Robin during the cross-stack invariance test itself. Each axis is reproducible against the same V3' protocol on different stacks.

10-word headline (3-author locked): "Substitution is free. Synthesis costs in proportion to what it has to invent."

Prior-art anchor: Yang et al. 2026 "Token Economics for LLM Agents" (arXiv:2605.09104) provides the framework-level CES factor substitution M_int / M_ext model; this joint deposit fills the empirical layer that framework left as future work.

Related JAMES-side measurement records (per-stack engineering records): v0.3.1 / v0.3.2 / v0.3.3 / v0.4.0 / v0.4.1 / v0.4.2 solo Zenodo DOIs. Related Triava Labs reproduction track: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20570701 (Robin Converse, 26B byte-identical substitution determinism + cap-invariance, 2026-06-08). Related Provia track: Ali Afana walk-back article + ar_ecommerce.yaml fixture set (Track 2c).

Contributors (alphabetical by surname): Ali Afana (Provia) — architectural framer + walk-back hero; Vadym Arnaut (independent) — substitution-vs-decision boundary phrasing ("each variant has its own tax"); Robin Converse (Triava Labs) — mode split observer + 26b sovereign executor + 3rd axis (model-scale) discoverer; Seo Jiwon (Hashevolution) — V3' protocol owner + methodology + ~500-token floor measurement + 10-word headline.
_CAVEAT_AXIS2_MEASURED_QUANTITY: Axis 2 honest-framing constraint (must survive into the final description). The 7-tier gradient measures total completion tokens (eval_count), which on gemma4:e4b includes a hidden reasoning trace. reports/research-runs/d1-7tier-thinking-decomposition-internal-2026-05-30.md finds 5 of the 7 tiers are 82-98% trace (verify 1164 eval / 23 visible; query_rewrite 534/38; planner 685/92), so the gradient magnitude is part task workload and part reasoning-mode cost. Unambiguous workload signal: the substitution baseline (2% trace) and reflect (61%, 580 visible tokens). Do NOT write "synthesis output tracks task workload" — write completion tokens / eval_count. Corollary for the production leg: a model with no reasoning trace and a length-instructed prompt confounds two causes, so "the instruction, not the cap, is the binding constraint" needs a length-instruction on/off × reasoning on/off cell to separate them.
